ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated financial sanctions, UK OFSI, Australian DFAT consolidated list, and Vanuatu domestic AML/CFT designations under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2014 (as amended). Politically Exposed Persons (foreign and domestic, including family members and close associates) are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and senior management approval. Commercial screening databases may be used but results must be independently verified against primary official lists. CDD records, UBO statements, and risk assessments must be retained by the licensed registered agent for a minimum of five years following termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Company Registry online name search and registration portal (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages are Bislama, English, and French. International Company names must be in Latin script; any non-Latin-script trading name must be transliterated into Latin script for registration. The legal name must carry an English corporate suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', or an accepted equivalent. Names implying connection with the Government of Vanuatu, a foreign government, or regulated financial activity are restricted and require VFSC or ministerial approval.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Vanuatu (when used to imply official government sponsorship)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the VFSC registry issues written reasons. The applicant may (1) resubmit an amended name in the same application cycle; (2) file a formal written request for reconsideration with the VFSC Registrar within 10 business days of the rejection, attaching supporting evidence such as trademark registrations or evidence of goodwill; (3) if the Registrar maintains the refusal, seek administrative review before the Vanuatu Supreme Court under the Judicial Review Act [Cap 230] within 30 days. Separate name reservations beyond the 30-day window are not extendable; a fresh application is required unless the incorporation filing has already been lodged.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for International Companies. A physical registered office in Vanuatu and a VFSC-licensed registered agent are mandatory under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; the registered office must be the physical address of the licensed agent. No industry-specific premises requirement applies to ISIC 4638 wholesale trading activities, but a mail-forwarding-only virtual address is not acceptable as the statutory registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the IC's own premises, estimated at less than 5% annual probability for this low-risk dehydrated spices trading profile. However, the licensed registered agent's office is subject to scheduled and unannounced VFIU/VFSC AML/CFT compliance inspections, with file reviews commonly conducted with 1 to 2 months' prior written notice during on-site examinations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] of the Republic of Vanuatu; ss. 6-10 (incorporation and registration), s. 27 (registered office), ss. 45-48 (directors), s. 71 (company secretary), Schedule 2 (fee schedule).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Registry of International Companies, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 - Application for Registration as an International Company, filed together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Nil statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow or mandatory bank deposit requirement; issued shares may be subscribed at par value and denominated in any currency approved by the registered agent; the share register must record subscriber allotments at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION - [COMPANY NAME], an International Company registered under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] of Vanuatu. RESOLVED, that: (1) the allotment and issue of fully paid ordinary shares to the subscribers named in the register of members is hereby ratified; (2) the premises situated in Port Vila, Vanuatu, as filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, is adopted as the registered office of the Company; (3) [DIRECTOR NAME] is appointed sole Director and [SECRETARY NAME] is appointed Company Secretary, each consenting to act; (4) the Director is authorized to open banking facilities, execute export sale contracts, and procure plant health and phytosanitary certificates from Vanuatu Quarantine Inspection Services; and (5) the corporate seal, if adopted, is approved. Dated at Port Vila this [DAY] day of [MONTH], [YEAR].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via a licensed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to conduct a name availability search against the VFSC register of existing International Companies and reserved names. Submit the proposed corporate name which must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registration or a name reserved by the Government.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request form
Engagement letter with licensed registered agent
Certificate of good standing of the applicant (if corporate subscriber)
Passport copy of beneficial owner (KYC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, obtain a written VFSC query notice and resubmit up to three alternative ranked names within five business days; no additional state fee for an alternative name substitution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and Notary Public in Vanuatu.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. Insert the authorized share capital, subscriber allotment statement, registered office clause, and objects clause limited to the wholesale trading of dehydrated vegetables and spices. Arrange for the subscriber to execute the documents in the presence of a notary public or witness designated by the registered agent, with signatures dated before submission.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed)
Subscriber declaration of non-resident ownership
Directors' and secretary's consent to act
Notarized corporate KYC pack (passports, proof of address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC registry returns a deficiency in the charter documents, execute a supplemental amendment or corrected Memorandum/Articles via a board resolution of the subscribers and refile with the agent within seven business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VFSC Incorporation Application Submission and Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - Registry of International Companies.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, statutory declarations and consent forms. Pay the official incorporation government fee of USD 450 (or VUV equivalent) via the VFSC approved payment gateway or bank transfer, and obtain a stamped receipt of lodgment.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 (Application for Registration as an International Company)
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act of each director and company secretary
Registered office consent form from the Port Vila agent
Government fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, review the VFSC Notice of Deficiency or requisition letter, cure the stated irregularity, and resubmit corrected documentation within fourteen days; VFSC shall issue the certificate upon full compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registrar Posting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and the Registrar of International Companies.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon VFSC approval, collect the Certificate of Incorporation and the filed charter. Instruct the agent to post the company's details in the register, open the statutory minute book and share register, and ensure the registered office address and director/secretary particulars are recorded as filed. Subsequent annual license fee of approximately USD 250 becomes due to VFSC on each anniversary.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notice of registered office address
Statutory registers and seal certificate (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a clerical error in the company name, date or capitalization, file a written correction request to the Registrar with a statutory declaration; a corrected certificate is reissued within five business days at no additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Export Trade Readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial banks in Vanuatu (e.g. ANZ Vanuatu, BSP South Pacific, National Bank of Vanuatu) and Vanuatu Quarantine Inspection Services (VQIS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the corporate pack to the chosen bank, complete customer due diligence, and execute the account mandate for Swift LC and TT wire payment rails. Concurrently, register the company as an exporter with the Vanuatu Quarantine Inspection Services if direct shipment of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper is intended, and obtain a Commodity Exporter Registration Number.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certified Memorandum and Articles of Association
First Board Resolution authorizing bank accounts and signing officers
KYC/AML forms and source-of-funds declaration
Pro-forma trade contracts for dehydrated vegetable consignments
Exporter registration application to VQIS (if exporting directly)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, supplement the application with corporate structure charts, supplier purchase agreements, and customs declaration samples; alternatively, approach an alternate licensed bank via the registered agent within ten business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Quarantine Inspection Services (VQIS), Department of Agriculture, Livestock and Forestry, Ministry of Agriculture.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Plant Export Health and Phytosanitary Certificate for Dehydrated Vegetable Commodities (non-mandatory for pure wholesale trading; required per consignment for customs export clearance of food commodities).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management, pursuant to the Environment Act No. 12 of 2002.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Registration Only: wholesale trading and dry warehouse storage of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper is not a prescribed development under the Environment Act; no Full EIA Report or Preliminary Assessment is required absent a processing, fumigation or ammonia-refrigeration plant.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or effluent discharge is generated by dry goods trading; warehouse premises must comply with the Vanuatu Waste Management and Pollution Control Regulations for commercial solid waste segregation; no VOC-emitting manufacturing processes exist; any incidental dust from bulk handling must remain within the workplace respirable dust occupational exposure guidance (10 mg/m3 time-weighted average) and pest-control fumigation, if contracted, must use registered chemicals as approved by VQIS.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance Certificate from the Vanuatu Police Force - Fire Service Division for the registered office and warehouse; structural occupancy inspection by the Port Vila Municipal Authority for the leased premises; and Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) workplace registration with the Department of Labour, including a general workplace clearance covering safe racking, emergency exits, and fire extinguisher availability for the dry storage area.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; taxpayer portal and VAT registration administered through VCIR head office in Port Vila.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign International Company (IC) must first be incorporated under the Vanuatu International Companies Act through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). No national income tax TIN is issued or required for an IC that confines its activities to offshore business. If the IC voluntarily registers for Vanuatu VAT (e.g., to zero-rate exported goods or claim refunds on local inputs), it must submit Form VAT-01 to VCIR together with the VFSC certificate of incorporation, registered agent certificate, certified passport copies of beneficial owners/directors, proof of local registered office address, and a letter of engagement from a Vanuatu-resident tax agent. VCIR issues a VAT registration number intended for all customs and indirect tax filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election in its domestic tax legislation. An IC may voluntarily elect to register for VAT in respect of Vanuatu-source taxable supplies, thereby creating an island within the tax-exempt structure for domestic purchases and export zero-rating; all other offshore business receipts remain fully outside the territory of Vanuatu taxation. There is no available election to be treated as a taxable person for income tax purposes, as Vanuatu imposes no national income tax.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover threshold for mandatory registration of persons making taxable supplies in Vanuatu; exports and offshore supplies are zero-rated and do not count towards the threshold unless the supplier elects to register voluntarily. Foreign and non-resident suppliers with no physical presence in Vanuatu are generally outside the VAT net except for specifically enumerated imported services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or government-API e-invoicing mandate currently applies in Vanuatu. Taxpayers may issue paper or electronic VAT invoices, but must include prescribed particulars (supplier name, address, VAT number, invoice date and number, description and value, VAT rate and amount). VAT returns are filed periodically through the VCIR electronic filing system, and all supporting invoice and customs records must be retained for 6 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Vanuatu by the supplier or the supplier's customs agent, provided the goods are removed from Vanuatu within 90 days of supply and are supported by customs outward movement records. Supplies of offshore services are zero-rated when made for the direct benefit of a recipient who is outside Vanuatu or when the services relate to movable property exported from Vanuatu. The exporter must hold, before the VAT return due date, documentary evidence proving export and the identity of the foreign buyer; perishable dehydrated garlic and chili consignments must be accompanied by phytosanitary certificates and consistent weight/packing records.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Form C1/Export Entry) endorsed by Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical shipment from a Vanuatu port
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an authorised bank in Vanuatu or foreign-exchange evidence traceable to the foreign buyer
Commercial tax invoice with zero-rated indicator and VCIR VAT registration number
Phytosanitary certificate and export permit for dehydrated vegetables, spices, garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper (issued by Vanuatu Biosecurity)
Packing list, certificate of origin and container tracking documentation aligning to the HS classification of ISIC 4638 goods
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VCIR audit examination focuses on the completeness of the export evidence chain, the genuineness of the foreign buyer, and timely repatriation of export proceeds. If zero-rating is claimed without lawful export, or documentation is forged or materially inconsistent, VCIR may issue a retrospective assessment recovering VAT at 13% on the full invoice value, plus a penalty tax of up to 200% of the tax, monthly late-payment interest at 5%, and criminal sanctions including a fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment for up to 12 months. Audit assessments may reach back 6 years from the date of the offending VAT return, and a cancelled VAT registration will nullify future zero-rating privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as the designated exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 88] as amended by the Exchange Control (Amendment) Act 2008, together with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) as the statutory regulator of International Companies, authorized dealers, and licensed financial institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is a non-globally traded currency but is freely convertible for current and capital account purposes through RBV-licensed authorized dealers (ADs) in Vanuatu. A Vanuatu International Company (IC) organized under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is treated as a non-resident person and is exempt from exchange control restrictions applicable to residents; there is no statutory RBV approval requirement for receiving foreign currency, holding export proceeds in USD, or remitting dividends and profits to non-resident shareholders. Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax on ICs, so profit remittance is unrestricted and requires only a valid board resolution and the standard wire verification file. The material constraint is operational liquidity: VUV/USD interbank quotes are obtainable only through ADs and may carry material spreads and minimum ticket sizes. Accordingly, the treasury blueprint denominates all trade settlements, documentary credit operations, and liquidity balances in USD, EUR, AUD, NZD, or CNH, converting into VUV only to meet incidental domestic operating expenses.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods physically exported from Vanuatu, the exchange control regime requires that export proceeds be repatriated to an authorized dealer in Vanuatu within six months of exportation, with the exporter obliged to offer the foreign currency for conversion into VUV if directed by the RBV; in current administrative practice the RBV does not impose mandatory conversion ratios on export receipts. The covered business model (ISIC 4638, bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper export) is structured as a drop-shipment international trading conduit: merchandise moves directly from third-country origin suppliers to third-country destination buyers without transiting Vanuatu customs territory. The statutory export surrender regime therefore does not attach to the underlying sale proceeds. The IC will nevertheless maintain a comprehensive audit trailer for each shipment (signed supply agreements, commercial invoices, packing lists, full-set Bills of Lading, certificates of origin, phytosanitary and quality certificates, and SWIFT MT103/MT202 payment evidence) to demonstrate that no goods physically enter Vanuatu and that no export-proceeds surrender obligation arises. If any incidental consignment is ever shipped ex-Vanuatu, proceeds must be received within 180 days and may be retained in USD in a Vanuatu AD account without mandatory conversion, absent an express RBV direction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD multi-currency account; segregated inward capital sub-ledger maintained for paid-up share capital until verified

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (Vanuatu) Limited (BSP Vanuatu)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD/VUV account with trade finance desk for export documentary collections
Operational USD account integrated with commercial letter of credit issuance and confirmation facilities through its correspondent network
VUV-denominated domestic operational account only; limited USD trade finance capability for non-resident International Companies

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary rail and Medium only as a supplementary collection rail. Offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise Business, Airwallex, and similar platforms do not hold an RBV authorized-dealer license, do not offer VUV-denominated accounts, and cannot issue Vanuatu international bank account numbers. Any foreign-exchange or payment transaction performed in Vanuatu through an entity that is not an authorized dealer would contravene the Exchange Control Act [Cap 88] where the transaction involves a resident person; a VU International Company is non-resident for exchange control purposes, so offshore EMI processing of its own foreign-currency flows does not of itself breach the statute. However, Vanuatu ADs will not fund or settle commercial letter of credit operations through an EMI account, and beneficiary banks in source and destination jurisdictions frequently reject TT or LC settlements sourced from EMI multi-lateral rails owing to correspondent banking de-risking. The recommended architecture is therefore to anchor all treasury activity in a Vanuatu-licensed bank account and to use an EMI account, if at all, only for low-value recurring receivables collections from identified buyers, with weekly sweeps of balances to the Vanuatu operating account and full recording in the AML surveillance file.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of at least one director or authorized signatory at a Port Vila or Luganville branch is the default expectation of Vanuatu ADs for a newly incorporated International Company with fully non-resident ownership, no local operating premises, and no historical financial statements, in line with the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act [Cap 296] and VFSC/RBV due-diligence standards. Remote onboarding is available on a strictly case-by-case basis where the following are delivered through the VFSC-licensed registered agent as introducer: apostilled or consularized corporate documents, certified passport copies and proof of address for UBOs, notarized source-of-wealth and source-of-funds declarations, professional referee letters from domestic banks of the beneficial owners, and a live video-conference interview with the AD's compliance officer. Even where remote opening is granted, at least one physical attendance of a director or appointed company officer within 90 days of onboarding is strongly recommended to activate cross-border wire limits, LC facilities, and multi-currency hedging lines.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed International Company with no local physical office, no audited financial statements, tax-exempt status, and non-resident natural persons as ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, and Register of Members issued by the VFSC; notarized and legalized passports plus proof of residential address for every UBO; bank and professional references from the UBOs' domestic financial institutions; a signed Source of Wealth / Source of Funds statement with supporting brokerage, sales, or inheritance documentation; a board resolution appointing the VFSC-licensed registered agent; and a group structure chart demonstrating the commercial purpose of the trading conduit with a 12-month cash-flow projection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High cross-border wire frequency and velocity relative to stated share capital, with payments to suppliers in Indonesia, India, Vietnam, China, and the UAE inconsistent with a low-risk spices trading profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed framework supply agreements and proforma invoices from each origin supplier; issued purchase orders and export sales contracts with clear Incoterms; a transaction-level trade file per consignment containing full Bills of Lading, packing lists, GSP and certificates of origin, phytosanitary certificates, fumigation certificates, laboratory analysis, and quality reports; plus a projected 12-month cash-flow model reconciling each outgoing wire to an underlying commodity trade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to or from third-party payees not named as the contractual counterparty, invoice mismatches, or requests to divert settlement proceeds to a different account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A treasury operations mandate executed by the board that names authorized signatories, permitted payment rails, and a strict matching policy requiring each MT103 to name the contractual counterparty as beneficiary; any legitimate assignment or intercompany settlement supported by a tripartite novation agreement, a commercial reason declaration, and enhanced due-diligence review by the receiving AD; monthly reconciliation statements mapping every wire to a specific purchase order, invoice, and bill of lading, retained for at least seven years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction and sanctions exposure: UBOs, directors, suppliers, or buyers located in or connected to high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions triggering VFSC or MANTRA watchlists.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions-screening results from a reputable screening provider covering all UBOs, directors, suppliers, and buyers before onboarding and on a continuing per-transaction basis; certificates or jurisdiction questionnaires evidencing that no entity in the chain is incorporated in a sanctioned state; transactional flowcharts proving the absence of sanctions-affected corridors; a standing commitment to re-screen every counterparty on each transaction prior to release; and an engagement letter with a licensed compliance consultant providing semi-annual AML/CFT review opinions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Paid-up share capital from a non-resident beneficial owner is injected via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 where the shareholder is a corporate treasury) to the IC's USD operational account held with a Vanuatu-licensed authorized dealer such as ANZ Bank (Vanuatu) Limited or BRED Bank (Vanuatu) Limited, routed through the AD's USD correspondent network commonly located in New York, Sydney, or Hong Kong. The remittance instruction must carry the following compliant data fields: beneficiary account title equal to the IC's registered legal name; the VFSC registration number; the transaction narrative 'Share capital contribution / subscription for shares in [IC legal name]'; and a cross-reference to the board resolution approving the capital call. On receipt, the AD will require a certified copy of the share register, the allotment resolution, and the completed UBO/KYC file before crediting, and will issue an inward remittance advice with the balance-of-payments classification 'equity capital'. There is no minimum paid-up capital requirement and no RBV approval is needed for non-resident equity inflow, but the AD will apply source-of-funds verification on each material transfer. The funds must be recorded in the IC's statutory books as issued share capital, and any later return of capital or dividend distribution must be supported by a board resolution and, where directed by the AD, a certificate of solvency.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier settlements for bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper are cleared through two primary rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers from the Vanuatu operating account for open-account and cash-against-document trades; and (ii) commercial letters of credit issued and advised via SWIFT MT700 / MT710 / MT707 messages through the Vanuatu AD's correspondent banking arm in Sydney, Auckland, Singapore, or Hong Kong for documentary trade. As the VUV is not an internationally traded settlement currency, all LC obligations and TT payments are denominated in USD (or, on request, in EUR, AUD, or CNH) and debited against the IC's USD facility. For sight letters of credit issued in favor of origin suppliers, the negotiating bank presents the full documentary set (commercial invoice, full-set clean-on-board Bill of Lading, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate, packing list, weight list, and insurance certificate) under UCP 600; the Vanuatu AD releases funds on compliant presentation and sends settlement advice via SWIFT MT103 or MT202. Where the IC sells under a documentary credit confirmed by a prime buyer-side bank, the IC presents documents through the Vanuatu AD and proceeds are credited to its USD account after negotiation or acceptance. Each outbound disbursement is matched to the underlying purchase order, customs declaration, and LC file, and the entire set is retained in the AML/CFT monitoring record; third-party collection accounts are restricted to identified trade-finance banks only.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV foreign-exchange forwards with tenors up to 12 months executed with a Vanuatu-licensed authorized dealer (ANZ, BSP, or BRED) to hedge residual VUV operating expenditures such as registered agent fees and local compliance costs

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing the USD/VUV exchange rate with international counterparty banks, permissible for a non-resident International Company without RBV prior approval because the company is not a resident person under the Exchange Control Act

Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR, USD/AUD, USD/CNH, and USD/NZD) entered into with the authorized dealer or its offshore affiliate to swap trade-receivable currencies into the settlement currency, supported by an underlying trade cash-flow forecast and purchase order pipeline

FX options and zero-cost collar structures (purchase of out-of-the-money puts and calls) with maturities aligned to LC settlement dates, premiums and settlement flows cleared through the Vanuatu operating account

Multi-currency nostro sweep arrangements among USD, EUR, AUD, CNH, NZD, and GBP as a natural-hedge overlay, retaining proceeds in the preferred settlement currency rather than converting to VUV in order to minimize conversion points and spread costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registration Fee Payment (International Company Annual Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following the anniversary of incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty accruing at 10% per annum on the outstanding fee; if unpaid for 90 days after the due date, the VFSC may issue an administrative strike-off notice, after a further 30 days the company is dissolved and struck from the Companies Register, resulting in loss of legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Return (for qualifying Distribution and Service Centre activity)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Economic Substance Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months of the close of each financial year (if financial year ends 31 December, filing due by 31 December of the following calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Potential penalty of not less than technically-complex non-compliance and up to 500,000 Vatu (USD 4,000) for failure to file or incomplete filing; continued non-compliance may lead to the imposition of economic substance assessment, potential additional penalties, and the VFSC may refer the matter to the Minister for non-renewal of registration or strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for a Vanuatu International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act. No annual financial statements or audit report must be filed with the VFSC unless the IC is engaged in a licensed activity (e.g., insurance or banking), subject to an audited financial covenant imposed by a lender or chargee, or selected for audit by shareholder special resolution. In normal trading circumstances, the Company is exempt from mandatory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB, or US GAAP when there is a controlling US shareholder; the IC is also permitted to prepare accounts under any recognized accounting standards adopted by a professional chartered institute. Vanuatu National GAAP is not applicable to International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Vanuatu Beneficial Ownership (Amendment) Act, as applicable to International Companies, the IC must obtain and hold accurate and current beneficial ownership information. Each year, the board of directors submits a written confirmation of initial and changed beneficial ownership details to the licensed registered agent, who updates the Company’s Beneficial Ownership Register. No submission to the VFSC is required for standard activities; the Register must be produced to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) or the regulator upon lawful request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 5,000 (only if voluntarily prepared or required by third-party covenant)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or branch profit tax on any resident or non-resident company; the former Income Tax Act has been fully repealed and no income tax legislation is in force).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company (IC) statutory exemption under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] s. 139: permanent exemption from income tax, VAT, customs duties, stamp duty, and all withholding taxes. Bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper exports (ISIC 4638) qualify as wholly offshore trading provided no supply is made to Vanuatu residents; effective tax rate on export margin = 0%. The only recurring fiscal charges are the VFSC annual government license fee and registered-agent service fees.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (ICAR-1) — filed through the licensed registered agent via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-services portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before each anniversary of the IC's date of incorporation; Vanuatu has no fiscal tax year for income tax purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered company name and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact English name from the certificate of incorporation; no local Vanuatu trade name is permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu (must be the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Supplied automatically by the agent; the non-resident owner must never list a personal residential address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State total capitalization and class of shares; bearer shares must be immobilized with the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, officers, and ultimate beneficial owner identification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach passport copy, proof of address, and bank reference for each non-resident director and beneficial owner; update within 30 days of any change.
Declare the dehydrated-spices export trade and certify that no business was transacted with Vanuatu residents during the year (IC Act s. 6 compliance).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent's certificate of good standing and annual license fee acknowledgment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent certifies payment of the VFSC government fee; retain a stamped copy as banking 'good standing' evidence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of VUV 25,000 per overdue return plus interest accruing on any unpaid VFSC license fee; persistent default for approximately 3 months triggers company strike-off under the IC Act, resulting in frozen bank accounts and loss of control over corporate assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (s. 20, Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 302]) — electronic filing through the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRCD) taxpayer portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly (statutory default); quarterly filing available at the Commissioner's discretion for eligible small taxpayers.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and any net VAT remittance due by the last day of the month following the end of the tax period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT charged on taxable supplies made during the period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil for an IC under the s. 139 exemption; export consignments are zero-rated and reported in the export schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT paid on local purchases (freight, port handling, agent fees).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claimable only if the IC voluntarily registers for VAT; most export-only ICs stay outside the VAT net and absorb no local VAT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shipping documents, bill of lading, consignee, and FOB value of each export consignment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain the bill of lading and commercial invoice to prove physical export out of Vanuatu.
An IC normally declares nil; any refund claim will trigger a VRCD audit of the actual physical export flow.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing fixed penalty up to VUV 100,000 plus interest at 10% per annum on unpaid VAT; fraudulent misdeclaration penalty of 25% of the tax shortfall and criminal prosecution under the VAT Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; distributions paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders are exempt under IC Act s. 139 and require no tax clearance or exchange-control approval.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreement is in force for Vanuatu; treaty relief and Treaty Residence Certificate (TRC) procedures are not applicable. Profit is remitted by free SWIFT/TT wire transfer; the recipient jurisdiction applies its own CFC, dividend-participation, and PFIC rules. Best practice: attach board minutes declaring the dividend, audited management accounts, and the VFSC certificate of good standing to the remittance file.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% domestic withholding on cross-border royalties and debt interest (no WHT statute exists); treaty rates are unavailable absent a DTA. A Vanuatu IC may receive license fees for the dehydrated-spice brand without deduction provided the IP is genuinely owned and administered from Vanuatu.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing, thin-capitalization, or CFC legislation; no Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country report is required or accepted by VFSC. The IC nonetheless retains a commercial pricing file for each export transaction.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP — prevailing international wholesale quote for dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili at destination port (preferred for commodity trades)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) are not separately enacted for Vanuatu ICs; substance is enforced through (i) IC Act s. 6 prohibition on carrying on business with Vanuatu residents, (ii) the statutory prohibition on holding or leasing Vanuatu land, and (iii) the obligation to maintain a registered office and registered agent in Port Vila. To prevent foreign tax re-characterization as a shell, the IC must evidence genuine operational substance: negotiated supply contracts, inspection/quality certificates for the garlic and chili, title transfer documents, settlement through the IC's own bank account, and active board oversight of pricing and buyer credit risk.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC is operated as a bare invoice conduit with no actual purchase or resale of dehydrated vegetables, nominee officers without knowledge, no bank account in the IC's own name, or no records available to the VFSC registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off under IC Act s. 252 and fines up to VUV 1,000,000 for false statements to VFSC; foreign financial intelligence units receive the transaction reports, triggering downstream criminal investigation in the buyer jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face 3-year disqualification orders, travel bans, and asset restraint orders; courts pierce the corporate veil to order civil restitution of all funds moved through the sham entity plus the beneficiary's profit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using spice-export invoices to launder third-party criminal proceeds through over-invoicing, phantom shipments, double billing, or commingling unrelated client funds in the IC's SWIFT accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act and the Proceeds of Crime Act; imprisonment up to 20 years and/or fines up to VUV 50,000,000; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may issue asset-freeze orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal custodial sentences, international travel bans, confiscation of personal assets, and permanent disqualification from holding any corporate office in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying export declarations, understating consignment FOB values, or issuing backdated invoices for dehydrated spices to generate false foreign tax credits in the buyer's jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Customs Act [Cap. 246], penalty of 100% of evaded duty plus fines up to VUV 1,000,000; VAT Act fraud penalty of 25% of the shortfall; foreign tax authorities deny treaty benefits and impose gross-up withholding on the full margin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false declarations are prosecuted personally; civil recovery orders follow proceeds into personal bank accounts; travel bans and imprisonment of up to 7 years apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: IC Act Breach / Unlicensed Domestic Trade
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling dehydrated garlic or chili to Vanuatu residents, importing goods for local resale, or holding a local business license in the name of the IC — all prohibited offshore conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under IC Act s. 6: fine up to VUV 1,000,000 plus VUV 50,000 per day during continuous breach; revocation of IC status and compulsory re-registration as a domestic company, retroactively exposing the entity to 12.5% VAT, customs duty, and the full domestic tax regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized local trading face personal fines, imprisonment up to 2 years, and joint and several liability for VAT and customs duties assessed on the IC.
